title: fix(plugin-detail): a related list that already shows 0 keeps showing 0 while it reloads
body:
Fixes #36822
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化:记录页上的相关列表原本显示 0 条,重新加载(删除、筛选或其它刷新)时数量角标不再消失,一直显示 0;第一次加载还没结果时、加载失败后点重试时,仍不显示数字,不会显示假的 0。
- 为什么做:记录页加载状态的后续收尾,替上一张「加载中不显示假的 0」的卡补上刷新时角标闪没的一半。
- 出错会怎样:刷新期间角标显示上一次成功加载的数字,直到新结果到达;加载失败后、或上级记录重新加载时,数字不再显示,直到新结果到达。改动只在一个组件内,可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## Responsibility
- Whose code: the platform's own `@object-ui/plugin-detail` `RelatedList`.
- Existing platform path: none; the badge has one read, `countPending`.
- Who reaches it: anyone whose related list empties on a refetch (after a delete, a filter, or a reparent).

## What changes
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`: `countPending` now also requires `!countKnown`. `countKnown` is set to true only where a read the list actually issued resolves (the record-payload seeded read, the `dataSource.find` read, the raw-URL read), and set back to false where one of those reads rejects, because the rejection empties the rows and 0 is not their count. A path that reads nothing never sets it: the no-scope early return (parent still loading, `parentId` null), a refused filter, the no-adapter refusals. The paths among those that empty the rows without reading (the no-scope return and both no-adapter refusals) also set it back to false, so an earlier count does not survive them. Result:
  - a refetch over a list that already answered 0 keeps drawing 0 instead of blanking the badge;
  - a failed read forgets the count, so Retry's read draws no count, never a false 0;
  - a parent that reloads through no scope forgets the count too, so the new parent's read draws no count, never a false 0;
  - a list's first real read, including one that starts only once the parent has loaded, draws nothing while in flight (the #36235 rule);
  - a list that answered rows behaves as before.
- Pins: a new top-level `describe` for #36822 in the existing badge harness `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.countPending-36235.test.tsx`.
- One `patch` changeset for `@object-ui/plugin-detail`.

## Files to read first
1. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`, the `countKnown` / `countPending` hunk: the only behaviour change.
2. The `#36822` describe in the test file: the held in-flight frame assertions (refetch, Retry, first scoped read, read after a scope loss).

## Two-minute check
`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.countPending-36235.test.tsx` — expect 8 passed.

## Tests
- `a list that answered 0 keeps drawing 0 through a refetch that answers no rows`: holds the refetch in flight and asserts the badge reads `0` on that held frame; that assertion carries the pin. A MutationObserver also samples the badge across the refetch and finds no reading other than `0`. It is a secondary signal only: it samples when its callback runs, not on each commit, so two commits inside one task would be coalesced.
- `a list that answered rows draws their count through a refetch, then the 0 it answers`: `2` during the held refetch, then `0`, nothing else in between.
- `a read that fails after rows were known draws no count while Retry reads, never a false 0`: answers 2 rows, makes the refetch reject, clicks Retry, holds Retry's read and asserts no badge, then `0` once it answers no rows.
- `a list with no scope on its first render draws no count during its first real read`: renders with `parentId` null (no read is sent), rerenders with the parent id, holds that first read and asserts no badge, then `2`.
- `a list whose parent reloads through no scope draws no count during the new parent's read`: `ACC-1` answers 2 rows (badge `2`), then `parentId` null (no read), then `ACC-2` with its read held: no badge on that frame, then `1`.
- The #36235 pins (first read draws nothing, CONTROL empty read draws 0, compact card) stay green.

<details><summary>Readings (head 8bfd2f7057, origin/main merged at 83585e7fa3)</summary>

- Pin file: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 8 passed (8)`.
- Full plugin-detail suite (`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/`): `Test Files 418 passed | 1 skipped (419)`, `Tests 3951 passed | 18 skipped (3969)`, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail run type-check`: exit 0 (the test file is in the `tsconfig.test.json` program).
- Ablations with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Each mutation landed (anchor 1 to 0) and was restored to blob == HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty.
  - Round 1, at `1426a1d54928`:
    - A1: `!countKnown` dropped from `countPending`. The 0-refetch pin fails on the held frame (`expected null to be '0'`).
    - A2: `setCountKnown(false)` removed from the `find` rejection. The Retry pin fails (`expected '0' to be null`).
    - A3: `setCountKnown(true)` added to the no-scope early return. The first-scoped-read pin fails (`expected '0' to be null`).
    - Each run read `1 failed | 6 passed (7)`.
  - Round 2, at `c6a0a1451618`:
    - A4: `setCountKnown(false)` removed from the no-scope early return. The scope-loss pin fails (`expected '0' to be null`), `1 failed | 7 passed (8)`.
    - A1, re-run: the 0-refetch pin fails (`expected null to be '0'`), `1 failed | 7 passed (8)`.
  - The N-rows pin stays green under every mutation. That is expected, since that behaviour held before the fix.
</details>

## Acceptance notes
- `countKnown` is not reset when the parent or the list's filter changes directly, from one scope to the next: such a list keeps drawing its last count during the new read, as it already did when its last answer had rows. A parent that reloads through no scope (`parentId` null while the parent record loads) empties the rows without reading and forgets the count, so the new parent's read draws nothing.
- Not changed here: while the parent record is still loading and the list has no scope yet, nothing is read, `loading` is false and the badge draws `0`. That is the same on `main` (read from the code, not measured in a browser). This PR only makes sure that phase does not mark the count known, so the first real read draws nothing.
- Browser reach was not measured; the pins mount the real `RelatedList` in jsdom with a deferred `find`.

## Verification
- Gate families derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` for this diff are run locally; CI-only families (type-check lanes, whole-tree families) are left to the PR's check-runs.
